title: Single-channel ocular-artifact reconstruction
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: EEGdenoiseNet semisynthetic EOG mixtures: 2000 paired training and 600 test 512-sample segments; component-disjoint split; per-mixture standardization. Primary mean per-segment temporal relative RMSE; not downstream clinical efficacy.

existing_reference.name: Training-pair stationary Wiener spectral shrinkage
problems: Weak compared with task-trained neural denoisers; never label current specialist best.
Original clean EEG has algorithmic processing and no recoverable participant IDs.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: EEGdenoiseNet original CNN/RNN models
candidates.information_match: Closest reproducible initial neural comparator; retrain on these exact pairs, not original randomized mixtures.

candidates.name: Gated WGAN with multi-scale/multi-domain features
candidates.evidence: B/C: recent EOG-specific primary article; executable weights unverified.
candidates.information_match: Single-channel paired EOG target is close; source partition, SNR and normalization still differ.

candidates.name: FARU-Net
candidates.information_match: Potential direct architecture fit; requires retraining on supplied training pairs.

candidates.name: Diff-ADN
candidates.evidence: B/C: current primary single-channel denoising abstract.
candidates.information_match: Promising reconstruction candidate; no confirmed code/checkpoint and no matched test execution.

candidates.name: ART
candidates.information_match: Native multichannel inputs unavailable; not a drop-in H16 comparator.

recommended_next_comparator: Retrain a pinned EEGdenoiseNet residual CNN/U-Net on the fixed paired training components; consider the 2026 EOG-specific gated-WGAN/FARU-Net once code is audited.
switching_assessment: UPGRADE comparator coverage prospectively, high priority, Tier B for neural task fit and C for unverified recent artifacts. Preserve Wiener as conventional baseline. Do not import spectral-RMSE, correlation or BCI-accuracy claims as temporal RRMSE.
limitations: No participant IDs: component disjointness does not prove person disjointness.
Mixture/SNR generation and normalization differ among publications.
MDPI pages rate-limited; some recent methods have only primary indexed abstracts available.
Diff-ADN publication date verified as 2026-10-30, not confused with indexing/search dates.
Training a neural denoiser exceeds the existing no-specialist-import one-shot code regime and needs its own declared budget.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
